dct_description_sm: Contributors: College of William & Mary. Geospatial Evaluation and Observation Lab, cartographer
Publication statement: Williamsburg, Virginia : William & Mary geoLab, 2021.

The CGAZ dataset provides single-file integrations of all international boundaries at three different geographic scales, ADM0 (Country Boundaries), ADM1 (States) and ADM2 (Municipalities). Polygon gaps are filled and polygon edges are simplified. Contested areas are defined using US Department of State definitions.
Three shapefiles (ADMN 0, 1, and 3) for a combined file size of 393 MB.
